evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MOLE, an open benchmark of 150 AI-operated accounts sharing 9 stateful services over 30 workdays, with 12 threats and 8 corpora from four models totaling roughly 20 billion tokens.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: MOLE enables comparison of 40 monitors across corpus generators, observability levels, and threats; even the best evaluated monitor in our single-day audit-event comparison misses nearly half of completed harm.
